channel.description: Channel username (e.g. '@mychannel') or numeric channel ID (e.g. '-1001234567890')

output_dir.description: Directory to save downloaded files. Defaults to ~/Downloads/telegram if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to scan (default 50). Increase to reach older history.

min_id.description: Only scan messages with ID greater than this value. Use the last downloaded message_id for incremental runs.
